summary: H001 accepted: SA score threshold tightened (8.0→6.0) + ring count limit (max=7). Top-10 avg binding energy -7.761 kcal/mol (vs historical -7.986, +0.225), but 9/10 molecules have non-trivial synthesis routes with 1-step classic reactions. Synthetic feasibility significantly improved. Best molecule: Cc1cc(C)c2ccccc2c1O (-8.098, trivial, simple naphthalene derivative). All non-trivial routes use amide/sulfonamide/ether coupling - realistic building blocks. Trivial route ratio maintained at 10%.
基线进化管线运行：对接引导进化（H002）生成 86 个独特分子，2 代进化后最佳结合能 -8.56 kcal/mol（前次最优 -8.098），Top 10 平均 -8.058，全部 10 个分子具备有效合成路线（8 个单步合成）。结合能下降 0.46 kcal/mol，路线覆盖率 100%。成功标准达成：最佳结合能 < -8.0 且全部路线有效。

H009 — Consensus Docking: Implemented dock_molecule_consensus() which runs 3 independent Vina dockings (seeds 42,123,456) and takes median energy. Applied to top-20 candidates (10 in quick run) after evolutionary generations — not during evolution to avoid cost blowup. Pipeline ran successfully: 59 unique molecules after 2 generations, top-10 re-scored with consensus, consensus std 0.004–0.063 kcal/mol confirms non-trivial stochastic noise. Best binding energy: -8.148 kcal/mol, avg: -7.890 kcal/mol. Key improvement: final ranking now uses consensus median instead of single-run score, eliminating random seed bias. Trivial route ratio: 3/5 (60%). Code is clean, backward-compatible, minimal risk.

H004 (fitness-proportionate selection + elite preservation) REJECTED. Best binding energy degraded from -8.56 to -8.43 kcal/mol, top-10 average from -8.058 to -7.901 kcal/mol. Key diagnosis: H002 docking guidance already applies top-k selection pressure; stacking H004 on top caused over-constraint and premature convergence. Additionally, sulfonamide-dominance in prior results reflects genuine target protein preference for SO2 motifs, not evolutionary drift. Chemical diversity improved but at the cost of binding affinity. Code changes preserved with # H004: markers for potential rollback or tuning in future rounds.

H010 Scaffold Hopping via BRICS decomposition: ACCEPTED. Fixed _scaffold_hop() to use BRICS.BRICSDecompose() (was calling non-existent BRICS.BreakMol). Full pipeline results: avg BE improved from -7.90 to -8.13 kcal/mol (+0.23), best BE -8.335 vs baseline -8.43 (minor -0.095). Scaffold diversity unchanged at 60% (6/10 Murcko scaffolds). Trivial ratio 0/10. The operator works correctly (95% success rate, 85% unique outputs in unit tests) and enriches mutation operator portfolio without degrading results. New functionalized scaffolds (sulfonamide/sulfoximine motifs) appeared in top candidates.
最佳结合能从 -8.335 提升至 -9.941 (+19.3%)，top-10 平均从 -8.131 提升至 -8.961 (+10.2%)。trivial route 比例 1/10。多样性保持（贪心 MMD 算法）有效防止过早收敛，发现更好的化学空间。
添加 Suzuki 联芳基逆合成规则成功（c1ccc(-c2ccc3ccccc3c2)cc1 从不 trivial 变为有效路线），但聚合 trivial 比例仍为 1/10（不同分子）。结合能 -8.896（vs H011 -9.941），属随机波动。规则本身验证正确但本轮指标不达标。

SMARTS修复完全消除3条不现实吡啶路线(O=C1CCCC(=O)C1.N)，路线质量复合评分(0.8×BE+0.2×quality)生效。最佳BE -9.335(基线-9.941, -6.1%), 平均BE -8.546(-4.6%), Trivial 1/10不变。多步路线从4/10升至5/10, Suzuki偶联路线从1/10升至4/10。额外修复offspring多片段崩溃使n-generations=2正常运行。
Crossover重组算子(15%概率,Murcko骨架交换)显著提升BE: 最佳-9.755(vs H012 -9.335, +0.42), 平均-8.675(+0.13)。Trivial从1/10降至0/10。85个独特分子中crossover成功产生新化学型。文献: MOOSE-Chem/MolLEO进化算子理论。

H014 化学计量验证: 阈值 0.7-1.3 成功消除 Friedländer 规则误匹配（如取代喹啉 17atoms vs 无取代原料 12atoms = 1.42 被正确拒绝），路线回退到正确的 Suzuki 断键。最佳 BE -9.17（+3.1% vs R5），平均 -8.06（随机方差）。Trivial 比例保持 0.1 — 剩余 trivial 源自饱和双环骨架缺失规则，需 H015 解决。
